# Machine Tracking Application

A React application for managing machines across manufacturers, factories, and recyclers with QR code scanning capabilities.

## Project Structure

- `src/pages/` - Page components for each route
- `src/components/` - Reusable UI components
- `src/services/` - API and data management services
- `src/hooks/` - Custom React hooks
- `src/styles/` - Global and component styles
- `public/` - Static assets

## Features

- Role-based navigation (Manufacturer, Factory, Service Representative, Recycler)
- Role selection with localStorage persistence
- Manufacturer dashboard with machine management
- QR code scanner for machine tracking
- Machine details and service tracking
- Recycler summary dashboard
- Service representative scanning capabilities
